name: Spine Guard
tagline: A clip-on sensor that tracks your back angle and shames or praises your posture, with a live dashboard.
problem: Device use leaves people with poor posture and health problems.
solution: An ESP32 with an IMU attached to clothing streams angles over Wi-Fi to a web app that scores posture, counts corrections and sitting time.
demo_moment: Team-described: slouch and watch the score drop and the device scold you.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Humorous feedback ('shame or glaze') makes behaviour change fun.

lessons: A small wearable with a personality beats a dashboard alone.
